title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
author: Ernest Hemingway
summary: An American explosives expert fighting with Spanish guerrillas in 1937 is sent to blow up a bridge in the mountains. Over three days he joins a band of fighters and falls in love with a young woman there.
readIf: you want a compressed, intense war novel with a clear mission and a ticking clock.
skipIf: you dislike long, interior stretches of talk and philosophising, or graphic memories of political violence.

pairings.reason: A shorter and more romantic war novel from the same author, less about politics and more about private loss.
Another war novel that slowly pulls apart romantic ideas about soldiers and loyalty.
A very different, satirical view of war, in which the absurdity is the horror.
